# Artimist Productions

Official website: https://www.artimistproductions.com

Artimist Productions is an international multidisciplinary architecture, design, BIM and visualization studio. The studio works with homeowners, architects, developers, builders and brands worldwide, with active business focus in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Sweden.

## Core services

- Architecture and residential design
- Custom house design and floor plans
- Interior design and 3D interior visualization
- Residential renovation and permit-documentation support
- BIM modeling and Revit drafting
- CAD drafting and construction-documentation support
- Scan-to-BIM and model coordination
- Architectural visualization and 3D rendering
- Interior and exterior rendering
- Architectural animation and walkthroughs
- Unreal Engine and real-time architectural experiences
- Branding, web and creative production where relevant to a project

## International delivery

Artimist can work with clients worldwide through digital collaboration, structured review stages and editable source-file handover. Priority markets include the USA, UK, Canada and Sweden.

Permit, planning, building-code and professional-licensing requirements vary by jurisdiction. When local law or an authority requires a locally licensed architect, engineer or other professional to review or stamp documents, Artimist coordinates with that professional rather than claiming that remote services replace local licensure.
